title: Friendly Senior Living
description:
Hospitals & Physicians Clinics

Friendly Senior Living offers a range of independent assisted living and senior apartments designed to meet the lifestyle preferences and changing care needs of seniors. Their services include independent senior living, assisted living, memory care, transitional care, and skilled nursing care across various communities. With a history dating back to 1849, they are committed to providing compassionate care and quality offerings for their residents. The company aims to enhance the lives of seniors in Rochester through a continuum of care and community support.
